channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Examining How Detroit Lions Can Restructure Penei Sewell’s Contract to Free Up Cap Space
item.description: The Detroit Lions can free up $12–15 million in 2026 cap space by restructuring Penei Sewell’s contract using bonus conversions and void years. Here’s how it works.

item.title: Ex-Lions General Manager Bob Quinn Gets Another NFL Opportunity
item.description: Former Detroit Lions general manager Bob Quinn has joined the Atlanta Falcons as a senior advisor after his tenure with Cleveland and his firing in Detroit alongside Matt Patricia in 2020.

item.title: Detroit Lions Land Akheem Mesidor in Daniel Jeremiah’s 2026 NFL Mock Draft 1.0
item.description: Daniel Jeremiah’s 2026 NFL Mock Draft has the Detroit Lions selecting Miami EDGE Akheem Mesidor, finally giving Aidan Hutchinson the elite pass-rush partner fans have been clamoring for.

item.title: Detroit Lions Assistant Lands OC Interview with Baltimore Ravens
item.description: The Baltimore Ravens are set to interview Detroit Lions assistant head coach and wide receivers coach Scottie Montgomery for their offensive coordinator vacancy, per Tom Pelissero.

item.title: Snubbed Detroit Lions Captain Named to Pro Bowl Games Roster
item.description: Detroit Lions quarterback Jared Goff has been named to the 2026 Pro Bowl Games, replacing Sam Darnold after throwing for 4,564 yards and 34 touchdowns in the 2025 season.

item.title: Report: Dan Campbell Keeps Important Piece of Defensive Staff in Detroit
item.description: The Detroit Lions have reached a deal to retain defensive assistant Jim O’Neil after he interviewed for the Jets’ defensive coordinator job, keeping a key piece of Dan Campbell’s staff in Detroit.

item.title: Detroit Lions Spend ‘Significant Time’ Talking to Duo-Threat QB Prospect at Senior Bowl
item.description: The Detroit Lions reportedly spent extended time meeting with Georgia Tech QB Haynes King at the Senior Bowl, evaluating the elite athlete and late Day 3/UDFA prospect as a potential developmental option behind Jared Goff.

item.title: Detroit Red Wings Reveal Unfortunate Simon Edvinsson Injury Update
item.description: Detroit Red Wings defenseman Simon Edvinsson is out with a lower-body injury until at least the Olympic break. Here’s what it means for the Wings’ blue line and Atlantic Division race.

item.title: Detroit Lions Hire Former Giants OC Mike Kafka
item.description: Former Giants interim head coach and offensive coordinator Mike Kafka is joining Dan Campbell’s staff in Detroit in a high-ranking offensive role, giving the Lions another elite young coaching mind.

item.title: Why Brock Wright and Sam LaPorta Are Taking on Michigan Lawmakers
item.description: Brock Wright, Sam LaPorta, and other members of the Detroit Lions are pushing Michigan lawmakers to pass Queenie’s Law, which would ban painful dog experiments at taxpayer-funded universities.
